This value-destroying performance is compounded by a negative return on assets of -4.78%, lagging far behind the sector benchmark of 1.37% [E7]. However, dismissing the business on these metrics ignores the extraordinary top-line momentum demonstrated by a 5-year compounded sales growth of 75%, a 3-year compounded sales growth of 80%, and recent screen reasons confirming strong sales growth alongside quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year sales increases [E13, E14, E52, E53, E55]. While the bear characterizes recent price dynamics as speculative froth where price growth exceeds profit growth by 667% [E46], this divergence captures the market beginning to reprice the underlying top-line expansion rather than reflecting fundamental permanent impairment.

However, the bull's attempt to frame top-line momentum as a justification for valuation ignores the catastrophic collapse in profitability where compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months sits at -706% [E16]. This extreme disconnect means that surging sales are actively destroying value, evidenced by a deeply negative ROE of -20.28% and an ROA of -4.78% against sector benchmarks of 4.67% and 1.37% respectively [E7, E8, E16]. Furthermore, dismissing the scanX signal engine warning that price growth exceeds profit growth by 667% as mere repricing is unfounded when the sector median profit growth is positive at 16.3% while this business posts multi-hundred percent losses [E16, E46, E62]. The market trading the stock at only 16% of its 52-week range accurately reflects the reality that top-line expansion without earnings is fundamentally unsustainable [E4, E16].
